scenario_selection.candidate_sampling: uniform reservoir across all 50000 complete paths
scenario_selection.interpretation: The selected path is within 5% of minimum average surprise; when a previous scenario exists, continuity breaks statistically close ties. The champion is never forced.

remaining_blockers: Official 2026 knockout slot mapping is absent from repository data; the isolated fallback remains non-official.

Penalty shootouts use a strongly shrunk Elo signal because usable shootout history is sparse.
